GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 4th on rail (2.5L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in straight. # Struggled from turn
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Lengths 800m 5th 3 Lengths home turn Under Pressure 6th no run on Straight # poor run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 800m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Synthetic Hoof Filler OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start. Raced keenly middle stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages and passing the 600m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and went forward, Five Wide initially, in 3 Wide and narrow Leader at the 1050m, Headed 800m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a half length, Lost Ground in Straight # worked a bit early
Blundered on jumping, Eased & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, one-paced in Straight # Wide early/plugged
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping and bumped shortly after. Raced wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.  Momentarily held up on heels near the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , held rails inside Leader 1 Lengths 700m, stayed back inside but had chance last 200m, peaked soon after and weakened # weakened 200m
Jumped okay & Settled Down 4th 2 Lengths Two Wide , improved to equal 2nd 2 Lengths on fence turning, couldn't come on in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 2 Lengths Held Together Out On A Limb to Straightening Up Couldn'T Go On @ 400m, was $201, was poorly in at weights - # Outclassed
Jumped Well way out wide. camped Wide No Cover =4th all of 3 Lengths @ 750m. Ridden Along Straightening Up all Clear , Gradually Gave Ground # wide/faded out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide, without cover, throughout the early stages before obtaining cover in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well out widest. camped 3 Wide 3rd No Cover within 1 length @ 700m. Under Pressure home Turn Straightened Up back to 4th all Clear Middle Of Track . Kept Trying all way # wide/fought on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead half clear, held together turn, Straightened Up narrow lead, still narrow lead 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on strong just no match winner final 50m # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.
